settings.text: All Patrick Adair Designs products are handmade, made to order. Our production timelines vary for each ring based on many things including but not limited to - material availability, labor availability, and order volume. Furthermore, our production timelines are merely estimates and are not guarantees. We will do our absolute best to get your order shipped within our current estimated timelines but by placing an order, you are acknowledging production delays may occur due to the things listed above. We will do our best to notify you if any delays do occur. If you have any questions regarding the status of your order or are needing your order sooner than the current estimated timeline (i.e. for a wedding), email us at support@patrickadairdesigns.com

settings.title: Shipping Information and Rates
settings.text:
United States Orders

USPS First Class (3-5 business days once shipped): FREE

International Orders

All international orders are shipped through DHL Worldwide Express or UPS Worldwide Expedited. Rates are location based. You can estimate the cost of shipping by entering your mailing address in the checkout phase. 

All orders with order value greater than $700 ship for FREE with DHL Worldwide Express.
